subject: Agriculture
title: Fungi: The Silent Killers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Fungi: The Silent Killers usable.

hook.text: Fungi cause 80% of all plant diseases. They rot, wilt, rust, and blight everything from wheat to bananas.

buildup.text: Fungal spores travel on wind, water, and soil. They can survive dormant for years waiting for the right host.

discovery.text: Wheat rust—a fungus—can devastate entire regions in a single growing season if resistant varieties aren't planted.

twist.text: A new wheat rust strain called Ug99 appeared in Uganda in 1999 and has spread toward Asia's breadbaskets.

climax.text: Breeding rust-resistant wheat is a constant arms race—new resistance genes are overcome within years.

punchline.text: Fungi evolve to beat resistance as fast as we create it.

quiz.question: What percentage of plant diseases are caused by fungi?
